title: crateva adansonii subsp. axillaris
intro: Crateva adansonii subsp. axillaris, commonly known as the African medinilla, is a plant species that belongs to the Capparaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its reported health benefits. Crateva adansonii subsp. axillaris is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
